sentences.text: The available policy text covers credit cards and delayed payment only at the level of “penal charges, if any,” and it does not state a specific late payment fee amount for credit card dues.
The policy materials also say that the bank’s policy must clearly lay down liability by way of interest payments due to delays for non-compliance with the bank’s own standards.
I could not find a specific late payment fee figure for credit card dues in the cited policy materials, so the amount is missing.
